question_entry.question: When Company regions face a Crisis, which regions are attacked, in what order and at what strength? How is defense mounted and what happens on successful defense?

key_entry.expected_answer: Resolve the primary Crisis first, then secondary Rebellions in every other Company-controlled region with unrest, in Bombay/Madras/Bengal Army order, with each Commander choosing associated regional order. A normal primary uses ordinary Invasion/Rebellion attack strength plus target unrest; a Foreign Invasion primary uses its ordinary attack die without unrest; each secondary uses only its local unrest. The associated Commander chooses and exhausts active Army pieces to meet attack strength, or as many as possible if insufficient; Military Affairs acts if Commander vacant, then Chairman if both vacant, and substitutes gain/lose no trophies. Apply this summary’s user-approved comparison: total strength of newly exhausted pieces equal to or greater than attack defeats the Crisis. Successful defense clears target unrest, awards the actual Commander one trophy (substitutes none), and if it defeats a normal primary Invasion removes one attacker tower if possible.
